currentText: Provide the franking credit component on the current-year dividend statements.
proposedText: Provide the franking credit component from your current-year dividend statements, including any TFN amounts withheld from unfranked dividends.
quote: amounts of franking credits - TFN amounts withheld from unfranked dividends. Franking credits are amounts of tax paid by the company that are allocated to your dividend or distribution.
rationale: Current wording only asks for franking credits. The guidance also requires TFN amounts withheld from unfranked dividends to be included in the unfranked dividend amount, which the current text omits.
